# Code Review Guidelines

## Review Process

- Review all code changes before merging to main branch
- Focus on code quality, security, and maintainability
- Provide constructive feedback with specific suggestions
- Test functionality locally when reviewing complex changes
- Ensure all tests pass and code follows project standards

## Review Checklist

- Code follows Dart and Jaspr best practices and conventions
- Functions and classes have clear, descriptive names
- Complex logic is properly documented and commented
- Error handling is implemented appropriately
- Performance implications have been considered
- Security vulnerabilities have been addressed

## Technical Review Areas

- Algorithm efficiency and data structure usage
- Memory management and resource cleanup
- Async/await usage and error propagation
- Component architecture and separation of concerns
- Test coverage for new functionality
- Documentation updates for public APIs

## Feedback Guidelines

- Be specific and provide examples or suggestions
- Focus on the code, not the person
- Explain the reasoning behind feedback
- Acknowledge good practices and improvements
- Prioritize feedback between critical and optional items

## GitHub Review Features

- Use inline comments for specific code suggestions
- Provide overall summary in review description
- Use GitHub's suggestion feature for small changes
- Request changes for critical issues, approve for minor items
- Link to relevant documentation or similar code examples

## Review Criteria

- Functionality works as expected and meets requirements
- Code is readable, maintainable, and follows project standards
- Performance impact is acceptable for the use case
- Security best practices are followed
- Tests adequately cover the new functionality
- Documentation is updated for user-facing changes
